description:
Find your flow. Chase the perfect route.

Swipe to roll through colorful 3D mazes, painting every tile along the way. Play at your own pace, or plan a smarter route and earn a Perfect solve.

RELAX INTO THE FLOW
Classic has no timer or move limit. Roll until a wall stops you, paint every path, and move straight into the next maze. Solo mazes are available offline.

CHASE THE PERFECT SOLVE
The first 1,000 Classic boards have verified minimum move counts. Match the target, earn a crown, and revisit completed levels to improve your best. Free hints guide you through your first five Classic levels.

SHARE A PUZZLE
Send a daily maze or a completed level to a friend with a picture and your move count. Challenge links open the same board in a separate play session, keeping regular progress safe.

FIND YOUR PACE
Time Rush: finish a five-maze round before one shared countdown ends.
Limited Moves: plan each turn within a swipe budget.
Daily Challenge: try a fresh maze each day and build your solve streak.

MAKE IT YOURS
Earn coins, unlock 18 ball skins across six rarities, and explore four worlds: Aurora, Timber, Porcelain, and Midnight. Adjust sounds and haptics, use VoiceOver movement actions, or enable Reduce Motion.

A GENTLER START
Enjoy free hints on unfinished Classic levels 1-5. Every launch gives you time to settle in before any between-level ads. Optional reward videos, when available, can offer hints, extra time, extra moves, skips, or bonus coins.

Prism Roll is free to download. Optional coin packs are available through in-app purchases. The No Ads purchase removes between-level advertisements; voluntary reward videos remain available. Game progress and coins are saved on your device. Sharing usage analytics is optional and can be changed in Settings.
